profile.reading: This record is named Cyxtera Dallas-Fort Worth Data Center in this registry, mapped to Tarrant County, Texas. No corporate website could be reached for this operator this session, and no independent secondary source describing this specific facility was found, so address, capacity, and square footage remain not published in this record. Cyxtera Technologies, headquartered in Coral Gables, Florida, entered into an Asset Purchase Agreement with Brookfield Infrastructure, disclosed via an SEC Form 8-K titled "Cyxtera x Brookfield APA Press Release" and filed November 2, 2023, per SEC EDGAR's full-text search index; this registry has not independently confirmed the full scope of that transaction (whether it covered Cyxtera's entire US colocation portfolio or a subset) beyond the filing's existence. Separately, Cologix, a different operator tracked elsewhere in this registry, acquired two specific Cyxtera facilities, VAN5 in Vancouver and MTL12 in Montreal, in 2023, per Cologix's own materials; those two Canadian facilities are unrelated to this Texas facility and to the Brookfield transaction. Cyxtera's own public website resolves but displays content that reads as dated (referencing a 2017 executive appointment) with no current facility locations list, and its data-centers subpage returns a certificate error, a combination consistent with a company mid-transition following the Brookfield transaction rather than one actively maintaining public marketing infrastructure. No square footage, MW capacity, or current operational status specific to this Dallas-Fort Worth facility was located in sourcing reachable this session.
